```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
```

DSEMr currently validates one intentionally narrow vertical slice: an N=1
Gaussian AR(1). This vignette demonstrates that slice without implying support
for later roadmap families.

```{r}
library(DSEMr)
dat <- simulate_dsem(n = 100, intercept = 0.2, ar = 0.5, sigma = 0.8, seed = 10)
model <- dsem_model("y ~ lag(y, 1)", time = "time")
fit <- dsem(model, dat, chains = 1, iter = 100, warmup = 50, seed = 10)
coef(fit)
```

Use longer chains and multiple chains for substantive work. Inspect convergence
information with `dsem_inspect(fit, "diagnostics")`.
